_note: Where a match was played, spelled one way. Sixteen distinct strings were
stored for about nine grounds, because a venue is typed by hand into the
match form and nothing checked it against what had been typed before.
The same ground read three different ways across three match reports.
This is a correction map, not a spell-checker: every entry is a variant
somebody actually typed, listed on purpose, so a new mistake shows up as
a new venue rather than being quietly absorbed. `npm run verify` prints
any venue it has never seen.
Two entries are the OPPONENT'S CLUB NAME typed into the venue field on an
away tie: 'Woking Veterans Sundays' and 'Tattenham Rovers'. Neither is a
ground and no ground name can be invented for one, but each does say
where the game was in the way a Sunday-league player would say it, so
both stand. The club can name the ground in Control panel -> Results if
it knows it. Only the doubling in 'Tattenham Rovers Tattenham Rovers' is
corrected, because a name pasted in twice is a slip rather than a claim.
